message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: test cases

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 11 11 * *'
  push:
    branches: [ master, dev ]

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest ]
        extra: [ base, excel, cli, plot, all, dev ]
        python-version: [ '3.11', '3.12', '3.13' ]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            extra: all
            python-version: '3.12'
    env:
      EXTRAS: ${{ matrix.extra }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - if: matrix.extra == 'plot' || matrix.extra == 'all'
        name: Setup Graphviz
        uses: ts-graphviz/setup-graphviz@v1
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements/test.pip') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-n      - name: Install Test Dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements/test.pip
      - if: matrix.extra == 'base'
        name: Install Dependencies
        run: pip install -e .
      - if: matrix.extra != 'base'
        name: Install Dependencies
        run: pip install -e .[${{ matrix.extra }}]
      - name: Run Test
        run: coverage run --source=formulas -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py'
      - if: matrix.python-version == '3.12' && matrix.extra == 'all' && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        name: Run Coveralls
        run: coveralls --service=github",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a large matrix (19 jobs) and every job re-downloads pip dependencies with no cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) is supported: repeated dependency fetching is measurable across the matrix, and no equivalent cache exists. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip, keyed on runner OS, Python version, and the hash of requirements/test.pip, preserves all install and test steps/coverage while avoiding repeated downloads. It adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access beyond pip's existing behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
